subject: Medford Square and ADU Zoning Proposals
overview: The committee met with zoning consultants from Innes Associates to review proposed zoning changes for Medford Square and discuss an updated draft of the city's Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) ordinance. No votes were taken, and both items remain in committee for further revision.

items.title: Medford Square Zoning Map Proposal
items.summary: Zoning consultants presented proposed zoning changes for Medford Square, including new mixed-use subdistricts and street height profiles, which councillors and residents discussed with a focus on building heights near Interstate 93, traffic, shadows, and business mix.

items.title: Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) Ordinance Draft
items.summary: The committee reviewed an updated draft of the ADU ordinance designed to comply with state mandates, discussing local rules concerning setbacks, height limits, short-term rental bans, and special permits for second units.
